_about: Curated libraries and resources. Read by components_find / components_catalogue. 'registry' = shadcn-style registry (installable with `npx shadcn@latest add <item url>`); {name} is the item name. price/license marked 'check' were not verified: confirm before relying on them. Add your own entries in <project>/.drip/catalogue.json with the same shape.

entries.name: shadcn/ui
entries.what: Copy-in React + Tailwind components on Radix/Base UI. The default base layer: you own and restyle the code.
entries.useWhen: Any React/Tailwind app. Buttons, forms, dialogs, menus, tables, sheets, command palette.

entries.name: Radix Primitives
entries.what: Unstyled, accessible primitives (dialog, popover, menu, tabs…).
entries.useWhen: You want full control of the look with correct accessibility.
entries.avoidWhen: You want styled components out of the box.

entries.name: Base UI
entries.what: Unstyled accessible components from the Radix/MUI/Floating UI teams.
entries.useWhen: Headless base for a custom design system.

entries.name: React Aria Components
entries.what: Adobe's accessibility-first headless components; best-in-class date pickers, comboboxes, drag and drop.
entries.useWhen: Accessibility and i18n matter most; complex inputs.

entries.name: Ark UI
entries.what: Headless components for React, Vue, Solid and Svelte (state machines).
entries.useWhen: Non-React or multi-framework projects.

entries.name: Headless UI
entries.what: Tailwind Labs' unstyled components for React and Vue.
entries.useWhen: Small set of accessible primitives in a Tailwind project.

entries.name: coss ui
entries.what: Cal.com's open design system on Base UI: a large, polished shadcn-style registry.
entries.useWhen: Product UI that should feel like a mature SaaS (forms, settings, scheduling).

entries.name: Kibo UI
entries.what: The complex parts shadcn skips: data tables, kanban, gantt, dropzones, AI inputs, code blocks, color pickers.
entries.useWhen: Rich app features that would take days to build well.

entries.name: Magic UI
entries.what: Animated components and landing sections (marquees, bento grids, number tickers, shimmer buttons). Pro version sells full templates.
entries.useWhen: Marketing pages that should move a little.
entries.avoidWhen: Dense app UI; don't stack many effects on one page.

entries.name: Aceternity UI
entries.what: Flashy hero effects: spotlights, beams, 3D cards, parallax, text effects.
entries.useWhen: One signature moment on a landing page.
entries.avoidWhen: Overuse reads as template; never in app UI.

entries.name: React Bits
entries.what: Animated text, backgrounds, cursors and effects in JS/TS and CSS/Tailwind variants.
entries.useWhen: A hero background or text effect with character.
entries.avoidWhen: More than one or two per page.

entries.name: Motion Primitives
entries.what: Tasteful animated building blocks (text effects, morphing dialogs, carousels) on Motion.
entries.useWhen: Subtle, high-quality motion in product or marketing UI.

entries.name: Animate UI
entries.what: Animated versions of shadcn/Radix components plus backgrounds, buttons and text.
entries.useWhen: You want shadcn-like components that already animate well.

entries.name: Cult UI
entries.what: Distinctive animated components (dynamic island, texture cards, shift cards) and blocks.
entries.useWhen: A playful, crafted feel.

entries.name: 21st.dev
entries.what: Community marketplace of shadcn-style components and sections; has its own MCP (key needed).
entries.useWhen: Looking for many alternatives of one component or section.
entries.install: per component (npx shadcn add …) or the 21st MCP

entries.name: Preline UI
entries.what: Hundreds of Tailwind components and blocks with plain-JS behaviour; works without React.
entries.useWhen: HTML/Tailwind sites, non-React stacks.

entries.name: Bencho
entries.what: 150+ micro-interactions sorted by press, hover and drag.
entries.useWhen: Making buttons, toggles and cards feel physical.

entries.name: Tactile UI
entries.what: Components that behave like real hardware: knobs, switches, physical buttons.
entries.useWhen: Skeuomorphic or playful controls.

entries.name: Libraries.dev
entries.what: Directory of UI component libraries.
entries.useWhen: Finding a library for a niche need.

entries.name: Arc UI
entries.what: Component and block library (listed among anti-slop picks).
entries.useWhen: Alternative section designs.

entries.name: BeUI Pro
entries.what: Premium UI blocks.

entries.name: Board UI
entries.what: UI components collection.

entries.name: Affect UI
entries.what: UI components collection.

entries.name: Kobra Systems
entries.what: Design system components.

entries.name: UI Watermelon
entries.what: UI component collection.

entries.name: Clover UI
entries.what: UI component collection.

entries.name: spell.sh
entries.what: UI resource (listed in design-engineering posts).

entries.name: UI SDK
entries.what: Component SDK with docs.

entries.name: HorizonX
entries.what: Listed among anti-slop UI libraries.

entries.name: Grainient
entries.what: Grainy gradient backgrounds and textures.
entries.useWhen: Warm, tactile hero backgrounds instead of flat gradients.

entries.name: uberdesigner
entries.what: AI design tool listed among anti-slop resources.

entries.name: Motion (Framer Motion)
entries.what: The standard React/JS animation library: springs, layout animations, gestures, exit animations.
entries.useWhen: Any UI motion beyond simple CSS transitions.

entries.name: GSAP
entries.what: Timeline animation and ScrollTrigger for scroll-driven storytelling.
entries.useWhen: Choreographed scroll sequences, complex timelines.

entries.name: Lenis
entries.what: Smooth scrolling.
entries.useWhen: Scroll-heavy marketing pages with scroll effects.
entries.avoidWhen: App UI; it changes native scroll feel.

entries.name: cmdk
entries.what: Fast, composable command palette.
entries.useWhen: ⌘K menus.

entries.name: Vaul
entries.what: Drawer / bottom sheet with native-feeling drag.
entries.useWhen: Mobile sheets.

entries.name: Sonner
entries.what: Toasts that stack and animate well.
entries.useWhen: Any toast/notification.

entries.name: TanStack Table
entries.what: Headless data table logic: sorting, filtering, grouping, virtualisation.
entries.useWhen: Real data tables.

entries.name: Recharts
entries.what: Composable React charts; what shadcn charts use.
entries.useWhen: Standard dashboard charts.

entries.name: Tremor
entries.what: Dashboard components and charts for Tailwind.
entries.useWhen: Analytics dashboards quickly.

icons.name: Phosphor
icons.style: six weights incl. duotone and fill
icons.useWhen: You need weight variants or a friendlier feel.

icons.name: Tabler Icons
icons.useWhen: Large coverage in a consistent stroke style.

icons.name: Heroicons
icons.useWhen: Tailwind projects wanting a small, clean set.

icons.name: Hugeicons
icons.useWhen: Big coverage with a modern rounded look.

icons.name: Remix Icon
icons.useWhen: Need line + fill pairs for states.

references.name: Dribbble
references.what: Shots: UI, branding, illustration. Built into Drip (refs_*).

references.name: Godly
references.what: Curated, high-craft websites (web references with motion).

references.name: Mobbin
references.what: Real app screens and flows (iOS, Android, web).

references.name: SiteInspire
references.what: Clean, typographic websites by style and type.

imagery.name: Wikimedia Commons
imagery.what: Free-licensed photos and illustrations; built in (images_search).

imagery.name: Unsplash
imagery.what: High-quality free photos; built in with a free key (UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY).

imagery.name: Pexels
imagery.what: Free photos and videos; built in with a free key (PEXELS_API_KEY).

imagery.name: Openverse
imagery.what: CC-licensed media search; anonymous requests may be refused.
